description: List the data models (content types) defined in the current workspace. Use to answer 'do we have models / a Product model?' or to see what data structures already exist. Read-only and takes no input. Returns { count, models }; each model is { id, name, slug, description, fieldCount } - a summary without the fields themselves. For a model's fields and config use get_model; for its records use list_records.
name: list_models
title: List models
